pairs: Postquam autem audivit verba filiorum Laban dicentium:
But afterwards, he heard the words of the sons of Laban,
Tulit Jacob omnia quæ fuerunt patris nostri,
saying, “Jacob has taken all that was our father’s,
and being enlarged by his ability,
quod non esset erga se sicut heri et nudiustertius,
he observed that Laban’s face was not the same toward him as it was yesterday and the day before.
the Lord was saying to him,
“Return to the land of your fathers and to your generation,
and I will be with you.”
Misit, et vocavit Rachel et Liam in agrum,
He sent and called for Rachel and Leah,
in the field where he pastured the flocks,
Video faciem patris vestri quod non sit erga me sicut heri et nudiustertius:
“I see that your father’s face is not the same toward me as it was yesterday and the day before.
Deus autem patris mei fuit mecum.
But the God of my father has been with me.
Et ipsæ nostis quod totis viribus meis servierim patri vestro.
And you know that I have served your father with all my strength.
et mutavit mercedem meam decem vicibus:
and he has changed my wages ten times.
et tamen non dimisit eum Deus ut noceret mihi.
And yet God has not permitted him to harm me.
all the sheep gave birth to speckled newborns.
‘You will take whatever is white for your wages,’
all the flocks gave birth to white ones.
And it is God who has taken your father’s substance
Postquam enim conceptus ovium tempus advenerat,
For after the time had arrived for the ewes to conceive,
et vidi in somnis ascendentes mares super feminas,
and I saw in my sleep that the males climbing on the females were of variegated,
Dixitque angelus Dei ad me in somnis:
And the Angel of God said to me in my sleep,
et vide universos masculos ascendentes super feminas, varios,
and see that all the males climbing on the females are variegated,
Vidi enim omnia quæ fecit tibi Laban.
For I have seen all that Laban has done to you.
I am the God of Bethel,
and made a vow to me.
returning to the land of your nativity.’”
Numquid habemus residui quidquam in facultatibus et hæreditate domus patris nostri?
“Have we anything left behind among the resources and inheritance of our father’s house?
Has he not considered us as foreigners,
Sed Deus tulit opes patris nostri,
But God has taken our father’s riches
unde omnia quæ præcepit tibi Deus,
do all that God has instructed you.”
et impositis liberis ac conjugibus suis super camelos,
and having placed the children and his wives upon camels,
And he took all his substance and flocks,
and whatever he had acquired in Mesopotamia,
and he journeyed to his father Isaac,
pergens ad Isaac patrem suum in terram Chanaan.
Eo tempore ierat Laban ad tondendas oves,
At that time, Laban had gone to shear the sheep,
et Rachel furata est idola patris sui.
and so Rachel stole her father’s idols.
Noluitque Jacob confiteri socero suo quod fugeret.
And Jacob was not willing to confess to his father-in-law that he was fleeing.
Cumque abiisset tam ipse quam omnia quæ juris sui erant,
And when he had gone away with all such things that were justly his, and,
et amne transmisso pergeret contra montem Galaad,
having crossed the river, was continuing on toward Mount Gilead,
nuntiatum est Laban die tertio quod fugeret Jacob.
it was reported to Laban on the third day that Jacob had fled.
And taking his brothers with him,
he pursued him for seven days.
et comprehendit eum in monte Galaad.
And he overtook him at Mount Gilead.
Viditque in somnis dicentem sibi Deum:
And he saw in a dream, God saying to him,
Cave ne quidquam aspere loquaris contra Jacob.
“Beware that you not speak anything harsh against Jacob.”
Jamque Jacob extenderat in monte tabernaculum:
And now Jacob had pitched his tent at the mountain.
cumque ille consecutus fuisset eum cum fratribus suis,
And when he, with his brothers, had overtaken him,
in eodem monte Galaad fixit tentorium.
he set his tent at the same place at Mount Gilead.
ut clam me abigeres filias meas quasi captivas gladio?
departing from me in secret, with my daughters like captives of the sword?
Why would you want to flee without my knowledge
though I might have led you forward with gladness,
Non es passus ut oscularer filios meos
You have not permitted me to kiss my sons and daughters.
valet manus mea reddere tibi malum:
my hand has power to repay you with harm.
sed Deus patris vestri heri dixit mihi:
But the God of your father said to me yesterday,
Cave ne loquaris contra Jacob quidquam durius.
‘Beware that you not speak anything stern against Jacob.’
It may be that you desired to go to your own,
et desiderio erat tibi domus patris tui:
and that you longed for the house of your father.
But why have you stolen my gods?”
Quod inscio te profectus sum, timui ne violenter auferres filias tuas.
unknown to you, because I feared that you might take away your daughters by violence.
But, since you accuse me of theft,
with whomever you will find your gods,
let him be slain in the sight of our brothers. Search;
anything of yours that you will find with me,
Hæc dicens, ignorabat quod Rachel furata esset idola.
Now when he said this, he did not know that Rachel had stolen the idols.
And so Laban, entering the tent of Jacob,
And when he had entered the tent of Rachel,
illa festinans abscondit idola subter stramenta cameli,
she quickly hid the idols under the camel’s bedding,
And when he had searched the entire tent
Ne irascatur dominus meus quod coram te assurgere nequeo:
“Do not be angry, my lord, that I am unable to rise up in your sight,
quia juxta consuetudinem feminarum nunc accidit mihi:
because it has now happened to me according to the custom of women.”
So his careful search was thwarted.
et ob quod peccatum meum sic exarsisti post me,
or for what sin of mine, have you become so enraged against me
et scrutatus es omnem supellectilem meam?
and searched all the items of my house?
quid invenisti de cuncta substantia domus tuæ?
What have you found from all the substance of your house?
Place it here before my brothers,
et judicent inter me et te.
and let them judge between me and you.
For what reason have I been with you for twenty years?
oves tuæ et capræ steriles non fuerunt,
Your ewes and she-goats were not barren;
the rams of your flocks I did not consume.
nec captum a bestia ostendi tibi,
Neither did I reveal to you what was seized by the wild beast.
I replaced all that was damaged.
I was burned by heat and by frost,
and sleep fled from my eyes.
Sicque per viginti annos in domo tua servivi tibi,
And in this way, for twenty years, I have served you in your house:
immutasti quoque mercedem meam decem vicibus.
You have also changed my wages ten times.
Nisi Deus patris mei Abraham, et timor Isaac affuisset mihi,
If the God of my father Abraham and the fear of Isaac had not been close to me,
perhaps by now you would have sent me away naked.
afflictionem meam et laborem manuum mearum respexit Deus,
But God looked kindly on my affliction and the labor of my hands,
et omnia quæ cernis, mea sunt:
and all that you discern are mine.
quid possum facere filiis et nepotibus meis?
What can I do to my sons and grandchildren?
ut sit in testimonium inter me
let us enter into a pact,
so that it may be a testimony between me and you.”
And so Jacob took a stone,
and he set it up as a memorial.
And he said to his brothers,
made a tomb, and they ate upon it.
And Laban called it, ‘Tomb of Witness,’
each of them according to the fitness of his own language.
Tumulus iste erit testis inter me
“This tomb will be a witness between me and you this day.”
et idcirco appellatum est nomen ejus Galaad,
its name has been called Gilead,
“May the Lord consider and judge between us,
et judicet Dominus inter nos quando recesserimus a nobis,
when we will have withdrawn from one another.
et si introduxeris alias uxores super eas:
and if you bring in other wives over them,
nullus sermonis nostri testis est absque Deo,
no one is a witness of our words except God,
And again he said to Jacob.
et lapis quem erexi inter me et te,
this tomb and the stone that I have set up between me and you,
iste et lapis sint in testimonium,
si aut ego transiero illum pergens ad te,
in case either I cross beyond it going toward you,
or you cross beyond it thinking to harm me.
Juravit ergo Jacob per timorem patris sui Isaac:
Therefore, Jacob swore by the fear of his father Isaac.
And after he had immolated sacrifices on the mountain,
vocavit fratres suos ut ederent panem.
he called his brothers to eat bread.
Laban rose up in the night,
and he kissed his sons and daughters,
And he returned to his place.
